Senses.Explanation: The Four Heavenly Kings are a named fourfold company in inherited Buddha narratives and Chan speech. One monastic rule tells how they offer bowls to Shakyamuni; an unnamed monk asks Langting Jingting whether their heaven lies below Mount Sumeru; Sanyi Mingyu makes them speak after a world-burning image. These deployments establish the collective but do not reduce four figures to one deity.
